title: ProgrammingLanguage Entity
description: Defines programming language runtime installation. Used by lay to install interpreters, compilers, and version managers.

language.description: Language name (e.g., python, node, ruby, go, rust, java).

version_manager.description: Version manager to use (e.g., asdf, pyenv, nvm, rbenv, sdkman).

user.description: User for per-user install (when system_wide is false).

packages.description: Language-level packages to install (pip, npm, gem, etc.).

env.description: Environment variables to set (e.g., GOPATH, NODE_ENV).
